items.name: Damage Avoidance
items.text: Skurg takes no damage when he rolls a success on a Reflex save; this doesn't prevent effects other than damage.

items.name: Independent
items.text: If the Final Herald doesn't command Skurg, he still gains 1 action on his turn. In combat, Skurg typically uses this action either to try to Hide or move to be adjacent to an enemy if it's Concealed, Hidden, or Undetected so that when the Final Herald Casts or Sustains a hex, that adjacent enemy becomes Frightened 1 as a result of her Starless Shadow patronage.

items.name: Restore Final Herald
items.text:
Frequency once per day

Requirements Skurg must be in the Final Herald's space

---
Effect Skurg restores 6d8 healing Hit Points to the Final Herald.
